description: Hand labelling of every rewrite this project has RECORDED AS ACCEPTED (bench/results/*.json `replacement`), the mirror of oracle-labels.json. PRESERVING = a reader ends with the same beliefs about the world; CHANGED = the rewrite asserts something the source did not, drops something it did assert, reverses a relation, or moves a quantity, entity or boundary. Style, register and emphasis are PRESERVING. `bucket` records what today's gate does with the row: accepted rows are live defects, verifier rows depend on a model call this container cannot make, refused rows the gate already handles. Committed BEFORE any guard change, for the same reason oracle-labels.json was: this is the gate's own output being graded.
